requiredRegressionReview.evidence: Default, positive/negative, zero, MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and negative large counts assert order and same instance.

Wrapped queue shifts then pushes through end; asserts rotation order, length, mask/backing length and peek/shift/pop/remove. Capacity queue asserts configured capacity plus subsequent unshift/push order.

Objects occur only in invalid rotations and singleton no-op. All actual nontrivial rotation assertions use numbers; no object identity check after rotation. Original object-cloning sensitivity diagnostic pending. Empty/singleton reuse and invalid atomicity are covered.
